newsitem.title: SPAIN: Three blasts at Spanish courts, no injuries.
newsitem.headline: Three blasts at Spanish courts, no injuries.

text.p: Three bombs exploded on Saturday at regional courthouses in northern Spain, but no one was hurt, local media reported.
The first went off early in the morning at a courthouse in Vitoria, shattering windows, dislodging marble flagstones and damaging cars parked nearby.
Police received a warning minutes before a second bomb went off. It was hidden in a backpack and placed near the main door of the courthouse in San Sebastian.
The warning was made in the name of ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) guerrillas, who have killed some 800 people since starting a campaign for Basque independence in 1968.
A third bomb later exploded at the courthouse in Pamplona.
